lede: Know where to ride, stay, eat and refill in Radovljica.
intro: Radovljica sits on a terrace above the Sava a few kilometres from Bled, with a medieval old town at its centre. It is a crossroads for riders. D2 from Rateče to Ljubljana, G2 towards Bled and Bohinj and the Jakobova pot all pass through. Lesce, with the Lesce-Bled railway station, belongs to Radovljica, and so do Begunje and the villages under Dobrča and Begunjščica.

routes.title: Cycle routes through Radovljica
routes.body: Seven signed routes pass through Radovljica. The longest stretches here are on the Gorenjska branch of the Jakobova pot, with 23 km, and D2, with 20 km. G2 has 8 km on its 53 km way from Lesce towards Bohinj. LG6, from Bled to Podblica, runs 16 km through the municipality, and LG3, from Slovenski Javornik to Tržič, 7 km. For mountain bikes, Trans Karavanke and K32 head up under the Karavanke. Four rides are written up in full, among them Blejčanka, 76 km with 944 m of climbing, and K42 (Rožnovenska pot), 20 km with 369 m.

stays.title: Where to stay with your bike
stays.body: You have 25 places to stay in Radovljica and Lesce. 1A Adventure Hostel in Lesce is 80 metres from D2 and 200 metres from the Lesce-Bled station. Camping Radovljica is 220 metres from D2, next to the town pools and a short walk from the old town. On the old town square, Gostilna Lectar has nine rooms, 20 metres from LG6. Camping Šobec, by the river near Lesce, rents, stores and repairs bikes.

food.title: Where to stop and eat
food.body: Radovljica has 22 places to eat, and most of the ones in town are close to D2. Gostilna Lectar on the old town square has cooked Slovenian food since 1822 and keeps a gingerbread museum; it is open every day from 12:00 to 22:00. Pizzeria Matiček bakes in a bread oven in the centre, 80 metres from D2. Čajna soba, 20 metres from the route, is a tea shop where you can sit and taste. In Lesce, Krčma Mexico is open every day from 12:00 to 22:00, and Slaščičarna Lincer is a pastry shop 10 metres from D2.

practical.title: Water, repair and charging
practical.body: Water is easy to find: 21 of the 29 public water points are within 150 metres of a signed route. The one repair point is a bike shop, Obris Šport. Riding an e-bike? Radovljica has 2 public chargers.

sights.title: What to see on the way
sights.body: Several sights are a short stop from the routes. The Museum of Apiculture is 30 metres from LG6. Kamen Castle is 70 metres from Trans Karavanke, and the Museum of Hostages 90 metres from LG3. Podvin Castle is 90 metres from the Jakobova pot. Want a short walk? Peračica Waterfall is 570 metres off D2.
